children: Falcon Finance has scheduled an FF supply unlock for March 2027. The release covers about 203.06 million FF, equal to 5.73% of the circulating supply. It includes tokens allocated to the ecosystem, the foundation, investors and the team.
The release gives recipients the option to sell the newly unlocked tokens. Sales from these allocations could add selling pressure on FF.

title: Falcon Finance: Schedules Unlock of About 203 Million FF - Mar 2027
